### 🔵 Needs a closer look It alters core path-containment/credential-directory security policy (`validateCwdAllowed` → native realpath) used across the whole daemon and depends on real Windows CI plus pending independent review that are not yet complete. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR makes the directory-**Browse** feature enforce the same working-directory policy that explicit session creation already uses. Previously Browse was only restricted to `$HOME`; now it applies the shared workspace-root allowlist, the credential-directory deny-list, and the daemon config/state deny-list via `validateCwdAllowed` / the new `validateResolvedCwdAllowed`. To keep boundary resolution consistent with the promise-based `realpath` that Browse uses (so Windows 8.3 short names and their long spelling agree), all cwd/boundary resolution in `handler-utils.js` moves to `realpathSync.native`. It also adds an optional `requestId` nonce to the `list_directory`/`directory_listing` protocol so prefill checks and Browse navigation can be correlated after server-side path normalization, and surfaces a startup warning plus a "New Session" hint when a configured default cwd would be refused. **Changes:** - Server: Browse now shares the Create cwd policy (native-realpath boundaries, predicate-based `allowed` check, unified denial text); adds `warnInvalidDefaultCwd` startup diagnostic. - Protocol/store-core: optional `requestId` on `list_directory`/`directory_listing` (src + dist + types) for reply correlation. - Dashboard: `usePathAutocomplete` gains a prefill-check path, `CreateSessionModal` correlates Browse replies by nonce with a path fallback for older daemons and shows a non-browsable-prefill hint. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `packages/​server/​src/​handler-utils.js` | Extracts `validateResolvedCwdAllowed`; switches boundary/target resolution to `realpathSync.native`. | | `packages/​server/​src/​ws-file-ops/​browser.js` | `listDirectory` applies shared policy via `allowed` predicate, unified denial text, `config`/`requestId` params. | | `packages/​server/​src/​ws-file-ops/​common.js` | `isUnresolvablePathWithin`/`unresolvablePathError` accept a canonical-path predicate (fail-closed preserved). | | `packages/​server/​src/​handlers/​file-handlers.js` | Passes `ctx.services.config` and `msg.requestId` to `listDirectory`. | | `packages/​server/​src/​server-cli.js` | Adds `warnInvalidDefaultCwd`, invoked from the daemon session-manager factory. | | `packages/​server/​src/​ws-server.js` | Documents the optional `requestId` on the `directory_listing` frame. | | `packages/​protocol/​src/​schemas/​{client,server/​file-ops}.ts` (+dist) | Adds optional `requestId` to list/listing schemas. | | `packages/​store-core/​src/​handlers/​file.ts` | Extracts optional string `requestId` into the parsed payload. | | `packages/​dashboard/​src/​store/​{connection.ts,types.ts}` | `requestDirectoryListing` accepts a `requestId`; `DirectoryListing` carries it. | | `packages/​dashboard/​src/​hooks/​usePathAutocomplete.ts` | Adds prefill directory-check with nonce correlation and `enabled` gating. | | `packages/​dashboard/​src/​components/​CreateSessionModal.tsx` | Browse navigation nonce correlation + stale-callback guards; prefilled-directory hint. | | Test files (server/​protocol/​store-core/​dashboard) | Cover native-resolver parity, Browse policy, reply correlation, prefill hints. | The implementation is careful, well-documented, and broadly covered by new tests; I did not identify a concrete objective defect to flag inline.
Review effort: Balanced
